text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks B, E, and A after steep declines locked in losses; I should pause and assess fundamentals and my long-term plan before selling.","My account kept falling even when I made no trades, so doing nothing is not a guarantee of safety; I should review my overall risk and whether my holdings suit my retirement needs.","Selling part of Stock D at a gain did not prevent the account from losing value overall; I should judge decisions by the whole portfolio and preserve enough cash for living expenses."]}
